concerns.text: Modifying registration-harness.html to pre-compile Svelte components on the fly via unpkg CDN introduces runtime network dependencies in test harnesses.
The registration form validation errors and privacy settings tooltips rely on inline HTML/CSS markup in Svelte components, which could be refactored into reusable UI primitives.
The role normalization migration and repository implementation look solid, though future enhancements could include caching role lookups.
The Dossier and ontology schema tables are cleanly defined with foreign key constraints; index tuning on foreign keys could be added as volume grows.
